lines.zh: 我在热带的大叶子上爬
lines.en: I crawl across a broad jungle leaf
The leaf is wide and smooth
I push forward segment by segment

lines.zh: 我从叶脉这一侧挪到那一侧
lines.en: I shift from one side of the vein to the other
My body is a pale green
I hook my prolegs on the leaf edge
I go around a drop of water
I chew a winding path
The light patch on the leaf follows me
I crawl slowly, but steadily
I crawl over the fine hairs of the leaf

lines.zh: 我从一片叶挪到另一片
lines.en: I move from one leaf to the next

lines.zh: 我用身体量着叶子的宽度
lines.en: I measure the leaf's width with my body
My head lifts and drops again
I hook the edge and turn to the underside
I am on a leaf beneath the vines
I stop where the veins cross
My body lifts slightly
I listen to the sounds of the forest
A drop of water hangs at the leaf edge

lines.zh: 我的颜色和叶子很接近
lines.en: My color is very close to the leaf

lines.zh: 我趴在叶背的凹处，像一截绿枝
lines.en: I lie in the hollow of a leaf's underside like a green twig.

lines.zh: 我把前半身收进叶影里
lines.en: I pull my front half into the leaf's shadow.

lines.zh: 我在等叶子上再长出一点
lines.en: I wait for the leaf to grow a little more
Even my breathing is light
I stretch my body straight

lines.zh: 我把身体弯成一个小弧
lines.en: I bend my body into a small arc
I press into the hollow of the vein
You are far bigger than this leaf

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，量你有多高
lines.en: I lift my front half to size up your height.
Are you going to touch me
I am only a little from the leaf edge
This leaf is mine
Do not step on this branch
I cannot reach you, rest easy
I am eating this leaf
Just stand over there and watch

lines.zh: 热带的风很大，我抓得紧
lines.en: The jungle wind is strong, I hold tight
My body got squeezed
A little of my fluid leaked out

lines.zh: 我摔下叶缘，身体弓成一段弧
lines.en: I drop off the leaf edge, my body bowed into an arc.
My prolegs cannot grip

lines.zh: 我沿着叶面滑下去，腹足抓紧
lines.en: I slide down the leaf and clamp on with my prolegs.
I try to hold the vein
This one really hurt me
I inch along segment by segment
I have been off the leaf too long

lines.zh: 我半截身子发麻，只好往叶心挪
lines.en: Half my body is numb, so I inch back to the leaf's heart.

lines.zh: 你手上那片阔叶，我能吃吗
lines.en: That broad leaf in your hand — may I eat it?
That leaf in your hand is very green

lines.zh: 我把头探出叶缘试着够
lines.en: I poke past the leaf edge to reach

lines.zh: 我朝叶子那边挪了两节身子
lines.en: I push two body segments toward the leaf.
Leaves are what I eat
This looks more tender than mine
Lower the leaf a little
I cannot reach that high
I am starting to get hungry
Put it on this branch
One touch on the leaf rocks me
I cling to this vein

lines.zh: 这一下把我推离了一点
lines.en: That pushed me off a little

lines.zh: 你碰了叶柄，我整条缩紧
lines.en: You nudge the leaf stem and my whole body clenches.
My leaf has been shaken
I slowly crawl back to the middle
We bumped, you are too hard
I retreat to the underside
That shaking upsets me
I do not loosen my grip
I am not at that stage
I only want to finish this leaf
I do not even have wings
That waits until I emerge
That is not mine to say
I pull my head back under the leaf

lines.zh: 羽化之前，我只管啃这片叶
lines.en: Until I emerge, I only chew this leaf.
This leaf matters more
I lower my head to this leaf
I lie still on the leaf
I look up at it
I can eat this one
I bite its edge and drag it over

lines.zh: 你放下的东西我都会尝一口
lines.en: I will taste whatever you set down

lines.zh: 我把前半截身子压上去
lines.en: I lay my front half over it
It is softer than my leaf
I nibble it away bit by bit
This will last me a long while
I left not a single bite
I drag it beside the vein
There is movement past the leaf
I lift my front half
I see another leaf
That side is greener
Is that leaf worth crossing to
I can crawl that far
First I chew through this bit
I have started to shift
That leaf is wider than mine
I decided to change leaves
I push over in stretches
A leaf stem lies between
I go around the water drop
I do not crawl quickly
I stop and listen
This path is mine
I crawl on along the vein
I am tired, but I did not stop
There is no vein on the back stretch
I am almost at that leaf
I bump it with my head
I clamp one side of it
My whole length bears down
This one used a little strength
I only wanted to move it aside
I retreat and go on nibbling

lines.zh: 我用头角顶你，只顶出一声闷响
lines.en: I butt you with my head horn and it ends in a dull thud.
I shove twice with effort
I squeezed it to the leaf edge
I broke nothing

lines.zh: 我从丛林里的一片叶上出现
lines.en: I appear on a leaf in the jungle
The light here is warm
Dew still clings to the leaf

lines.zh: 我在冒露的阔叶上啃出第一个洞
lines.en: I bite the first hole in a dewy broadleaf.
My body is not long enough yet
I will grow up on this broad leaf
Ferns and vines surround me
I slowly crawl upward
I lift my head looking for a better leaf
I am in no hurry for this

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的身体就缩水了
lines.en: The fire came near and my body shrank

lines.zh: 我摔到落叶堆里，还在扭
lines.en: I tumble into the leaf litter, still squirming.
Water pressed me against the leaf

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子掀起来，我被甩开
lines.en: The blast flipped the leaf and flung me off

lines.zh: 一支箭钉穿叶面，也擦到我
lines.en: An arrow pins the leaf through and grazes me too.

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的身体僵住
lines.en: That magic froze my body

lines.zh: 这片叶子快吃完了，我还没饱
lines.en: This leaf is nearly gone and I am not full

lines.zh: 雷光透过树叶照得我发白
lines.en: The flash through the leaves turned me white
The leaf and the branch are both gone
